zh.title: 新功能
items: **CLI 一等发布**：GitHub Release 与 Desktop 同 tag 附带 `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`，可只装命令行、不装客户端。
**`peer --version`**：CLI 支持 `--version` / `-v`，编译产物会内嵌发布版本号。
**会话 @ 提及与图片附件（TUI）**：终端侧支持会话提及与图片附加，交互更接近客户端。
**Qoder 模型目录**：优先走官方 SDK 拉模型目录，并修复私有 API / CLI wasm 场景下的目录加载。

zh.title: 优化
items: TUI 模式标签、工具层级、状态栏与帮助文案更清晰；mode 展示与 Desktop「Agent」语义对齐。
TUI 压缩/恢复流程与侧栏「Load more」更稳。
外观设置重做为 theme workshop；布局 class 与调色板动效恢复。
应用图标统一主题化；Goal / Plan 面板与 Plan 页签可用性打磨。
新建任务 ⌘N 在输入框聚焦时也可触发。

zh.title: 修复
items: 切换会话时不再丢失 composer 排队消息。
侧栏会话 hover/active 边框样式清理。
microcompact 空闲时避免上下文占用中途回落。
TUI Qoder 私有路径、模型标签与 origin 工作区展示修正。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`。
归档内含 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper`，**必须放在同一目录**；不要只拷贝 `peer`。
安装：解压后将该目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 应输出 `peer 0.0.1-beta.38`，再运行 `peer`。
可不装 Desktop；会话与设置仍落在 `~/.peer-agent`，与客户端共享。

en.title: What's New
items: **CLI first-class release**: GitHub Release ships `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` under the same tag as Desktop so you can install CLI only.
**`peer --version`**: CLI supports `--version` / `-v`; build embeds the release version.
**Session @ mentions & image attachments (TUI)**: Terminal supports session mentions and image attach, closer to Desktop.
**Qoder model catalog**: Prefer the official SDK for catalogs; fixed private API / CLI wasm catalog loading.

en.title: Improvements
items: Theme workshop layout classes and palette motion restored.
App icons themed consistently; Goal / Plan panel and Plan tab usability polish.
New Task ⌘N works even when the composer is focused.

en.title: Fixes
items: Switching sessions no longer drops composer queued messages.
Cleaned sidebar session hover/active border styles.
Microcompact idle no longer drops context occupancy mid-way.
TUI Qoder private path, model labels, and origin workspace display fixes.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships the CLI archive under the same Desktop tag/version: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`.
Contains `peer` and `peer-credential-helper`; **must stay in the same directory**—do not copy only `peer`.
Install: unpack, add the directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version` (expect `peer 0.0.1-beta.38`), then `peer`.
Desktop is optional; sessions and settings still live under `~/.peer-agent` and are shared with the app.
